projects.name: 16 Prime Steakhouse
projects.summary: Custom PET felt clouds that shape an intimate, luxurious dining room.
story: 16 Prime Steakhouse sought to create an intimate, luxurious dining experience where acoustics played a crucial role in the atmosphere. The custom PET Felt clouds not only provide exceptional sound absorption but also serve as a striking visual centerpiece, echoing the sophisticated aesthetic of the restaurant while maintaining a comfortable conversational environment for guests.
